import copy, hashlib, json, subprocess, sys
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/"scripts"))
import contract_scores as cs
PRE="2e8913a68bcf518c572b778a4db2cf14f2cc5d04"
def sha(b):return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def blob(p):return subprocess.check_output(["git","show",PRE+":"+p],cwd=ROOT)
assert subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()==PRE
report={"AuthorityEffect":"None","reviewed_head":PRE,"repairs":[],"raw_history_records_unchanged":True,"current_contracts_and_scores_unchanged":True}
for name in ["functor","full_functor"]:
 rel=f"code/rust/src/category_theory/functor/{name}.contract.score.yaml"
 path=ROOT/rel; before=cs.load(path); d=copy.deepcopy(before)
 refs=defaultdict(list)
 for kind in ["contract_history","scoring_history"]:
  for e in d[kind]:
   for alias in e["original_paths"]:refs[alias].append((kind,e))
 collisions={k:v for k,v in refs.items() if len(v)>1}
 assert len(collisions)==1
 state=(d["current_contract"],d["current_scoring"],copy.deepcopy(d["contract"]))
 for old,owners in collisions.items():
  assert len(owners)==2 and set(k for k,_ in owners)=={"contract_history","scoring_history"}
  del d["legacy_paths"][old]
  fixes=[]
  for kind,e in owners:
   e["original_paths"].remove(old)
   new=old.replace("\\","/")+"-"+("contract" if kind=="contract_history" else "scoring")
   assert new not in d["legacy_paths"]
   cs.add(d,new,e["raw_utf8"].encode(), "contract" if kind=="contract_history" else "scoring")
   fixes.append({"kind":kind,"alias":new,"sha256":e["sha256"]})
  report["repairs"].append({"companion":rel,"removed_ambiguous_alias":old,"distinct_aliases":fixes,"before_sha256":sha(blob(rel))})
 d["current_contract"],d["current_scoring"],d["contract"]=state
 for kind in ["contract_history","scoring_history"]:
  assert [{k:v for k,v in e.items() if k!="original_paths"} for e in before[kind]]==[{k:v for k,v in e.items() if k!="original_paths"} for e in d[kind]]
 assert d["contract"]==before["contract"]
 assert d["current_contract"]==before["current_contract"] and d["current_scoring"]==before["current_scoring"]
 owners={}
 for kind in ["contract_history","scoring_history"]:
  for e in d[kind]:
   raw=e["raw_utf8"].encode()
   assert sha(raw)==e["sha256"] and len(raw)==e["bytes"]
   for alias in e["original_paths"]:
    assert "\\" not in alias and alias not in owners
    owners[alias]=e["sha256"]
 for alias,digest in d["legacy_paths"].items():assert owners[alias]==digest
 cs.save(path,d)
 loaded=cs.load(path)
 for fix in report["repairs"][-1]["distinct_aliases"]:
  assert loaded["legacy_paths"][fix["alias"]]==fix["sha256"]
  e=next(e for e in loaded[fix["kind"]] if fix["alias"] in e["original_paths"])
  assert sha(e["raw_utf8"].encode())==fix["sha256"]
 report["repairs"][-1]["after_sha256"]=sha(path.read_bytes())
review="evidence/quality/full_functor_validation/REVIEW.md"
old=blob(review)
addition=(
 "\nSuperseded (2026-10-23): explicit maintainer approval later permitted an\n"
 "exact-source baseline-floor exception for these source bytes; see\n"
 "evidence/quality/functor_shell_pr/exception_authorization.json. The L2D score\n"
 "and the global L4/D floor are unchanged. The assessment above is historical.\n")
(ROOT/review).write_bytes(old+addition.encode())
assert (ROOT/review).read_bytes().startswith(old)
report["historical_review"]={"path":review,"original_committed_prefix_sha256":sha(old),"original_prefix_preserved":True,"after_sha256":sha((ROOT/review).read_bytes())}
pins=json.loads((ROOT/"evidence/quality/functor_shell_pr/exception_authorization.json").read_bytes())["subjects"]
for p,assessment in pins.items():
 raw=(ROOT/p).read_bytes()
 assert raw==blob(p) and b"\r" not in raw and sha(raw)==assessment["sha256"]
baseline=ROOT/"governance/baseline.json"
assert baseline.read_bytes()==blob("governance/baseline.json")
for p in ["governance/policy.json","dag/derivation_dag.json"]:
 assert (ROOT/p).read_bytes()==blob(p)
report["protected_sources"]=pins
report["baseline_sha256"]=sha(baseline.read_bytes())
report["scientific_scope_fences_unchanged"]=True
report["limits"]="Alias metadata and a superseding process-status note only. No raw assessment, score token, source, baseline exception or scientific scope changed. Fragment aliases are record labels in legacy_paths, not newly introduced filesystem APIs."
out=ROOT/"evidence/quality/functor_shell_pr/review_fixes.json"
out.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8",newline="\n")
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
